name: dsh-prompt-enhance-ultra
description: DSH plugin: turn a rough draft in the chat composer into an executable prompt. The automatic mode classifies the draft and streams two candidates — a concise pass that keeps your own words and only adds execution notes, and the best-fitting methodology — each as long as the task needs; the advanced panel picks a family (code reads the workspace and audits security, creative enriches or structures a script, documentation fills an existing skeleton) and a length level (concise, default, thorough). Techniques adapt between Superpowers, Prompt Optimizer, LangGPT and AiShort.
author: EasonQuantico

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check strategies.js
